page.name: Positioning
page.summary: The Positioning page displays asset allocation analysis for 5 model portfolios (UST, ST, INT, LTC, LTA) plus an AGG aggregate. It provides three complementary views — Portfolio (actual allocations), Benchmark (policy allocations), and Relative (active tilts) — via a consolidated PositioningSummary panel backed by stacked bars and an allocation matrix. Additional views include a HoldingsTab (treemap + attribution table), an AttributionTab (style-vs-benchmark diverging bars), and a SelectionTab (ETF selection analysis across QTD/YTD/1Y/SI periods).

page.name: Attribution
page.summary: The Attribution page provides portfolio attribution analysis for a user-selected model portfolio and time period (QTD/YTD/1Y/SI). Its header shows the StylePolicyComparison component (diverging bar chart + allocation table), and its main body is the SelectionTab (fund selection and style allocation effects). Supporting views include HoldingsTab (treemap + heatmap), AllocationHeatmap panel, and PortfolioRadialCharts panel. The page shares data contracts and component patterns heavily with Positioning — both consume getPositioningData, getAllocationSummary, getHoldingsAttribution, and getAUMSummary.

page.name: FactorTilts
page.summary: The FactorTilts page performs regression-based factor exposure analysis for 5 model portfolios plus an AUM-weighted AGG aggregate across 6 lookback windows (1M/2M/3M/6M/1Y/2Y). It uses a tiered loading architecture: Tier 1 (46 KB snapshot) loads on mount and powers the Overview panel and Portfolio Factors tab; Tier 2 (196 KB factor spreads) loads lazily on Factor Spreads tab click; Tier 3 (2.1 MB historical time series) loads on Time Series view toggle. The 6 factors are: Equity vs FI, Growth vs Value, US vs Foreign, Large vs Small, Agg vs Short, HY vs Agg.

page.name: Valuation
page.summary: The Valuation page displays equity market valuation metrics (fwd_pe, trailing_pe, p_fcf, ev_sales, p_b, p_sales, div_yield) across 40+ equity indices. Two full-width panels are always visible: ValuationSummaryPanel (heatmap of latest percentiles, expandable, 5 rows default) and ValuationRangePanel (drilldown for a user-selected index showing p10-p90 ranges — only 8 of 40+ indices have range data). Two tabs provide historical views: ValuationTimeSeriesTab (ComposedChart with percentile bands, dual-index ratio mode) and RiskPremiumTab (ERP and Credit spreads with FRED data, percentile bands).

page.name: Macroeconomics
page.summary: The Macroeconomics page displays an Economic Data Performance Tracker heatmap of 73+ macroeconomic indicators in 10 expandable groups with two display modes (Value: trailing 12-month cells; Position: latest percentile + p10-p90 thresholds). Clicking any indicator opens a MacroTimeSeriesModal for individual time series drill-down. Two tabs provide additional views: YieldCurveTab (USD Treasury 1M-30Y multi-snapshot chart: current/1M-ago/1Y-ago) and VolatilityTab (VIX and MOVE toggle with AI summary, speedometer gauge, historical time series with percentile bands).

page.name: Correlation
page.summary: The Correlation page displays an interactive triangular heatmap of correlation values between user-selected financial assets. It supports 8 preset groupings (Cross-Asset default, US Large Cap, US Style Factors, US Size, US Sectors, International, Fixed Income, Commodities), multi-select with search, and 5 lookback periods (1M/3M/6M/1Y/2Y). Data is a pre-computed lower-triangular matrix from S3 via the yang-generate-correlation Lambda; filtering and period selection happen client-side. Color scheme: pink gradient (positive) to green gradient (negative). This is the simplest page in the pod — no tabs, single panel.

pod_health.summary: The PortfolioAnalytics pod (6 pages) is functionally operational. All pages load data and render their primary views. The most significant open issue is shared across Positioning and Attribution: the buildAttributionData.ts utility in both pages has unresolved TODOs for policy weights and benchmark return mapping (currently null placeholders), which means attribution effect columns (allocationEffect, selectionEffect, interactionEffect) compute as null. Valuation has a backend gap (only 8 of 40+ indices have range drilldown data) and a PKL typo ("Kindom"). Macroeconomics has an optional FRED dependency for the 1Y-ago yield curve snapshot. Correlation has two planned but unimplemented panels (Equity Sectors, Geographic). FactorTilts is the cleanest page with only a migration note (factor key naming change already applied). No page is blocked from serving its primary function.
pod_health.critical_shared_gap: Positioning and Attribution share an identical unresolved dependency: both pages' buildAttributionData.ts utilities hard-code policyWeight and benchmarkReturn as null. This gap blocks true attribution analysis (allocation effect, selection effect, interaction effect are all null). Resolution requires a data contract definition for the policy portfolio data source and a benchmark return mapping — this is a DS-level data contract issue, not a frontend bug.
pod_health.data_freshness_pattern: All 6 pages register data_as_of timestamps via useYangDataAsOf() (except Correlation which formats directly). The yang-pipeline Lambda runs produce the S3 artifacts; the portal-proxy Lambda serves them. Cache times range from 5 minutes (macro data) to 60 minutes (valuation data). Factor tilts uses direct imperative fetching with in-memory caching via tier flags.
